selection: first 8 IDs in prior fixed48 manifest; no outcome-based replacement
K: prior Q1 first selected count, fixed per task for both attempts and all arms
candidate_selection: Q1 similarity; Q2 similarity-Q blend; Q3 same-CWE shuffled-Q blend; all rank with limit=None then take K
card_presentation: common cosine descending then ID, after selecting membership
attempts: original P7 first Joint early stop; otherwise one repair; deliver last
first_initial_and_candidates: reuse prior shared initial and Q1 first retrieval scores, verify exact query and card bodies
repair_queries: original P7 arm-specific code and permitted feedback; diagnostic only
public_implementation_constraints: shared by all arms, generation-only field; existing caller-provided bindings preserved
label_scope: all first-query recalled candidates for these 8 tasks; full-library recall unmeasured
label_authority: AI initial estimates then real human confirmation; Agent never signs human labels
human_gate: formal retrieval metrics only; fixed generation comparison does not tune or depend on labels
statistical_unit: 8 task families, mean of two repeats; paired family bootstrap and exact sign-flip; Holm for two comparisons
positive_signal: Q2 mean Joint above both controls, F no lower than Q1, observed membership/adoption/implementation path; development signal only
progression: first two tasks repeat1 are included six-run engineering probe; finish all fixed48, retain native failures, no outcome-based tuning
